title: UG-035 — Provide background information to participants
intent: Convert an EUSurvey best-practice recommendation into a practical KB article.
short_answer: Tell participants what will happen with the survey results, whether and where results will be published, and the timeframe of the survey.
important_conditions: This recommendation comes from the EUSurvey best-practices guidance.
